test_evidence: Commit 66802f9d. catalogue-tenant-isolation.test.ts: 2 cases failed on the base source (a tenant-B principal read tenant A's artifact via x-tenant-id:A -> 200 instead of 404; runs-scope leak) exit 1 (evidence/L339-fail.log) and 2/2 pass after (evidence/L339-pass.log); backend-report 125/125; tsc exit 0; eslint 0 err; prettier clean.
notes: Topic 4 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). notes: Topic 2 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972).
